title: Experimental investigation of classical and quantum correlations under decoherence
subject: Physics
question: According to the main plot, what is the approximate value of the 'Total correlation (I)' (green upward-pointing triangles) when the 'Total thickness of quartz plates' is 100 λ₀?

gold_answer.long_answer: Locating 100 λ₀ on the x-axis of the main plot and tracing vertically to the green upward-pointing triangles (Total correlation (I)), then horizontally to the y-axis, the value is approximately 0.7.

original_caption:
The main plot displays the decay of various correlation measures as a function of the total thickness of quartz plates, expressed in units of λ₀ (ranging from 0 to 300). The y-axis represents “Correlations,” scaled from 0.0 to 1.2.

Five distinct correlation measures are plotted with corresponding symbols and theoretical curves:

- **Total correlation (I)**: Represented by green upward-pointing triangles with error bars. The data points follow a smooth exponential decay, starting near 1.05 at 0
